data.title: 一色彩羽 · 看台上尚热的红茶
data.description: 活动收尾后的足球场看台，彩羽穿珊瑚色防风外套和灰色运动长裤，坐着把一罐红茶推向身旁空位。另一罐握在自己手里；她抬起下巴装作随意，笑意却藏不住。夕阳与看台反光一起照亮脸部。
data.action: 把热红茶推向身旁空位，抬下巴掩饰笑意。
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki nudges a warm tea can toward the empty place beside her on the stadium bench, keeping the second can between her own hands. Her coral windbreaker and charcoal athletic trousers belong to an afternoon helping with the sports event. She lifts her chin with practiced nonchalance, but a small grin betrays the thoughtful gesture. Reflected sunset keeps the honey-brown eyes readable; the empty goal is distant behind the close seated figure. No second person, labels or text.
